description: Shared, editor-agnostic description of the read-only modulex MCP server's tool surface (ADR-0035 plan step 5: the VSCode and IntelliJ plugins share one description of the tool surface). The authoritative schemas live in tools/mcpserver/*.go; this file mirrors them for editor-plugin consumption and must be updated when they change. editors/vscode/src/toolSurface.ts is a typed mirror of this file.

server.name: modulex
server.command_hint_cwd: repository root of a modulex checkout

input.name: root
input.description: repository root to scan; defaults to "."

input.name: root
input.description: repository root containing modulex.agent.yaml; defaults to "."

tools.name: recommend_verification
tools.title: Recommend verification

input.name: changed_files
input.description: paths (relative to the repository root) that changed

tools.notes: plan.FocusedChecks / plan.FullGates use Go-default PascalCase field names (verify.Plan has no json tags).

input.name: checks
input.description: snake_case check specs: name, command, category, reason, required_tool, networked

input.name: allow_network
input.description: if false (default), a networked check is reported as skipped

input.name: base_ref
input.description: git ref to diff from, e.g. "origin/main"

input.name: head_ref
input.description: git ref to diff to, e.g. "HEAD"

input.name: allow_network
input.description: if false (default), a networked check is reported as skipped
